turns.teacher: Good morning children. Today we will do subtraction with bundles and sticks. Our first sum is fifty two minus twenty seven. Try it in your notebook, okay?
turns.label: new_sum

turns.teacher: Arjoon, you wrote 35. Can you tell me how you got it? Just tell me slowly, step by step.
turns.label: ask_to_explain

turns.teacher: Okay, so you said 2 is small, so you borrowed a ten and made it 12, and 12 minus 7 is 5. Then in tens you did 5 minus 2. Hmm... Arjun, after you borrowed that ten, how many tens are left in fifty two?
turns.label: targeted_question

turns.teacher: Come, Arjun, take these. Five bundles of ten and two loose sticks, this is fifty two. Now open one bundle for the ones. Count the bundles now, how many are still there?
turns.label: concrete_materials

turns.teacher: Yes! Four bundles only. So the tens column is 4 minus 2, not 5 minus 2. Arjun, what is the answer now?
turns.label: targeted_question

turns.teacher: Very nice, Arjun, you remembered to cut the 5 and write 4 after opening the bundle. That is exactly the step we needed.
turns.label: specific_praise

turns.teacher: Sana, I saw you also wrote 25. Can you show us with the sticks, quietly is fine?
turns.label: invite_quiet_child

turns.teacher: Okay, now everyone try sixty three minus twenty eight. Arjun, remember the bundle you open.
turns.label: new_sum
